maya: Quick follow-up from today's all-hands: we need a single source of truth for dates/owners for API, Console, and Optimize so comms to customers & sales are aligned. Keep replies short.
sam: TL;DR from product: API (hosted) GA internal: 2026-09-20, public: 2026-10-05. Console revamp GA: 2026-11-25. Optimize early beta: 2026-07-10. Owners: sam (API), olive (Console DX), jin (Optimize infra).
jin: Note: Optimize beta hinge = batching refactor + perf validation. Batching PR queued for canary testing 2026-06-24. If canary ok, we open beta.
olive: DevEx scope: migration guide + console quickstart + 2 sample apps. Drafts by 2026-07-20. I'll need one tech review from runtime before publishing.
noah: Leadership ask: API streaming + tools must be fully tested before public GA. Console admin features can remain staged (canary first). Decouple where possible.
zara: Sales request: simple bullet list of "what's shipping when" for reps. Need this by 2026-07-22 to prep customer outreach.
sam: Confirming scope: API GA = streaming, function calls, rate limits, basic metrics. Console GA = admin rollouts + model/route dashboards. Optimize beta = batching suggestions + quantization hints (no autosuggested patches).
jin: For Dedicated customers, autoscale change scheduled as a canary in August; will post a compatibility note and pilot plan by 2026-07-30.
olive: We'll freeze docs two weeks before each public GA. DevEx will coordinate with Solutions Eng for sample apps.
allhands-bot: Created ticket #9012 "AH: publish roadmap dates & owner list" assigned to sam, jin, olive. Due 2026-06-25.
maya: Please mark any blockers in ticket #9012 before EOD Wednesday so leadership can triage. Thanks.
